FAMILY 09 · CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 studyVolumetric Study FMs

Prima

Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。

Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 一个真实脑 MRI study 中的多序列 3D 体积、序列名称/描述与配对报告 Complete clinical brain MRI study (multiple heterogeneous 3D sequences + sequence metadata) + paired neuroradiology report
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 完整检查级 embedding、零样本相似度及冻结特征上的 52 任务 MLP 预测 Study-level multimodal embedding supporting zero-shot retrieval and 52 neurological diagnostic/triage MLP probes

MATHEMATICAL FORMALISM
核心公式 · 从三维子体积到序列再到检查级的层级对齐
Core Formalism · Three-Level Hierarchical Study Encoding (3D VQ-VAE → Sequence ViT → Study ViT) + Report CLIP
01 // PRIOR LIMITATION
上一代瓶颈

研究队列规模有限且筛选偏差大，模型难覆盖真实临床异质性

Curated research MRI models fail on real-world hospital studies containing variable numbers of sequences, protocols, and artifacts.

02 // CORE HYPOTHESIS
核心想法

以 VQ-VAE 把 MRI 体积离散化，再用 sequence ViT、study ViT 和 MRI-report CLIP 学习层级检查表征

Tokenize 3D sub-volumes via VQ-VAE and aggregate variable multi-sequence studies through hierarchical sequence- and study-level Transformers aligned with reports.

03 // ARCHITECTURAL DELTA
关键改进

以报告摘要对齐层级神经影像表示，冻结表示后训练 MLP probes

Trained on >200,000 uncurated clinical MRI series (~30,000 studies) with LLM-summarized report alignment and health-system-wide evaluation.

04 // MEDICAL TRANSLATION
医学适配

用于 52 种诊断、优先级与转诊建议等脑 MRI 任务

Evaluated across 52 neuroimaging diagnoses, acuity triage, and specialist referral recommendations over a 1-year health-system cohort.

05 // EVIDENCE & BOUNDARY
适用范围与证据

有一年 health-system-wide 与外部评估；仍主要来自单一卫生系统，尚未证明工作流结局改善

Strong health-system-scale study-level evidence; predominantly validated within a single health system and retrospective workflow.

ARCHITECTURAL AXIOMS // 设计原理与数学机制
  • 先用 VQ-VAE 把高分辨率 MRI volume 压成可处理的子体积 token。
  • Sequence ViT 建模单序列，Study ViT 再汇聚整个检查，保留真实 PACS 层级。
  • 以报告摘要做 CLIP 对齐；下游冻结表示，只训练轻量 MLP probes。
  • Core Hypothesis: Tokenize 3D sub-volumes via VQ-VAE and aggregate variable multi-sequence studies through hierarchical sequence- and study-level Transformers aligned with reports.
  • Architectural Delta: Trained on >200,000 uncurated clinical MRI series (~30,000 studies) with LLM-summarized report alignment and health-system-wide evaluation.
  • Mathematical Formalism: Three-Level Hierarchical Study Encoding (3D VQ-VAE → Sequence ViT → Study ViT) + Report CLIP.
CLINICAL TRANSLATION & BOUNDARIES // 医学应用与安全边界
  • 模型输入单位是完整 study，可同时利用序列组合、方向和报告语义。
  • 报告摘要和单卫生系统训练可能引入标签泄漏或流程偏差；优先级/转诊预测不等同于已改善临床结局。
  • Clinical Translation: Evaluated across 52 neuroimaging diagnoses, acuity triage, and specialist referral recommendations over a 1-year health-system cohort.
  • Evidence & Safety Boundary: Strong health-system-scale study-level evidence; predominantly validated within a single health system and retrospective workflow.
